name: Hybrid Gaussian Splatting
definition: A hybrid representation that decouples transient and static scene elements by using multi-view consistent 3D Gaussians for static scenes and single-view independent 2D Gaussians for transient objects per image.
summary: Hybrid Gaussian Splatting synthesizes novel views by decoupling static scenes into 3D Gaussians and transient objects into 2D Gaussians, preventing artifacts common in standard methods.
